spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense data, functional beauty, command-center feel. Mobile-first responsive, optical alignment.

grid_modes.command_center: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. 'Control Room' dense mode.
grid_modes.match_engine: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Sidebar col-span-4, main feed col-span-8.
grid_modes.profile_engine: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 'Bento' Mode A for visual capability mapping.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat background (bg-zinc-900), 1px subtle border (border-zinc-800), rounded-sm (2px). No soft shadows. On hover: border-cyan-500/50, slight bg shift.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.active_ai_cards: Use 'Tracing Beam' or subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)] to indicate AI activity or high-match items.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers: Solid background bg-black with border-b border-zinc-800. No transparent navbars.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.glassmorphism: Only for modals/dialogs: bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-zinc-800.

components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm (2px). Primary: bg-cyan-500 text-black hover:bg-cyan-400. Secondary: border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 text-white. All buttons must have specific focus/hover states.
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. bg-black border-zinc-800 focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500. font-mono for numbers.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts with pure high-contrast lines. Axis labels in IBM Plex Mono. Remove default grids, use dotted horizontal lines only.
components.badges: font-mono text-xs uppercase px-2 py-1 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300.
components.data_display: Use tabular, grid borders (border-collapse) for lists to emphasize the 'Technical/System' aesthetic.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST change border color or bg color on hover. transition-colors duration-200. Always ensure text contrast on hover.
motion_and_interactions.system_response: Motion = System Response. Use typing effects for AI logic, count-up animations for match scores.
motion_and_interactions.live_feed: Smooth entrance animations for new activity stream items (translate-y-2 to 0, opacity 0 to 1).

images.description: Abstract geometric pattern of illuminated lights
Account preferences screen with verification prompt

screens.Command Center: Real-time system view. Live activity stream (bento grid right col), progress indicators (donut charts/circular progress), AI suggestions (top row, tracing beam borders). UI adapts based on user role.
screens.Match Engine: List of internships/candidates with Match % in IBM Plex Mono. A 'Why this match?' AI logic block expanding on click to show transparent reasoning.
screens.Profile Engine: Dynamic capability model. Skill graph (Radar chart using Recharts), Improvement suggestions list, Strength scoring (Big numbers in Mono font).
screens.Feedback Engine: Behavior analysis timelines, UI priority adjustment toggles. Dense analytics view.
screens.Momentum System: Streaks represented by Volt Yellow accents, improvement graphs over time.

testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='submit-application-button'`).
